body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> ZENUS(representative Kim Kwang-mi, www.zenuscase.co.kr) introduced 'iPhone4 Swarovski Airjacket Crystal' case at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.
Swarovski Airjacket Crystal with red-wine color and shadow blck color is very spledid and luxury and it's durable because made of polycarbonate material.
ZENUS will open new website(www.zenuscaseusa.com) targeting North America late January and service much more products for consumers in North America.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
